title: shortify
tagline: Shortify delivers concise news summaries, making it easy to stay informed in less time.
description: Shortify is a smart news platform designed to provide quick and digestible summaries of lengthy news articles. By condensing complex stories into short, easy-to-read formats, Shortify helps users stay updated without spending too much time reading. Whether it's breaking news, global events, or industry insights, Shortify ensures you get the key points in seconds.
how_its_made:
Shortify is developed using Next.js for a seamless and efficient user experience. It leverages the Flow blockchain for secure and transparent news verification. To simplify the user onboarding process, we use Privy Wallet as a server wallet, abstracting the complexity of wallet creation from users.

For news summarization, Shortify integrates AI agents with advanced NLP to generate concise and accurate summaries. Additionally, these agents assign a confidence score to each news article. Only articles that meet a certain confidence threshold are published, ensuring credibility and reliability.

This combination of blockchain, AI-driven summarization, and confidence scoring creates a trustworthy and efficient platform for consuming news quickly.
